# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting | Mid-Market

**Regulation to analyze:** NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, NIST CSWP 29 (Feb. 26, 2024)
**Why:** Primary agricultural production has no binding federal cybersecurity regulation (farms are largely exempt from 21 CFR 121, which is a food-defense, not IT-security, rule). CSF 2.0 is the sector-neutral baseline referenced by USDA/CISA; use 21 CFR 121 as a supplemental checklist for any farm mixed-type facility that processes food.
